text:
Lela Lane: Hey everyone! I'm Lela — joining today as a PM on Growth. First day in the SF office, desk by the big ficus. I bake pancakes and sourdough on weekends and I collect tiny succulents and old typewriters. Bringing a small pancake batch tomorrow if anyone wants some. Also curious: best lunchtime spots near 5th & Market? :)

Ava Chen (People Ops): Welcome Lela!! :tada: Pancakes = absolutely yes. Recommend 'Batter & Bloom' two blocks over — lemon ricotta is my go-to. Also we'll do a quick welcome lunch at 12:30 today, team will meet at the lobby.

Raj Patel: hey welcome! For good espresso try Caffè Duomo on 7th. We also have a low-key keyboard meetup on Wednesdays in the lounge — typewriters -> mechanical keyboards crossover is a thing here :grin:

Maya Chen: hi Lela — i'm on DevEx. Ping me if you want a quick console walkthrough or help with dotfiles/setup. Also FYI we run a communal plant-watering rota if you want someone to help with the ficus while you're traveling.

Jordan (onboarding-bot): Jordan: Badge pickup reminder — Reception 10:00–11:30. Welcome lunch at 12:30 in the lobby. Onboarding checklist link: http://intranet/onboard/2840011223

Sofia Alvarez: Pancakes pls +1. Also heads up — someone brought a giant cat plush yesterday, not a real cat but you might see the meme thread :rofl:

Lela Lane: Haha allergic to real cats so glad it's plush-only :sweat_smile: I'll bring a gluten-free batch too. Thanks for the recs — i'll try Batter & Bloom this afternoon. Maya — will DM about console access. Excited to be here!

Raj Patel: :thumbsup: see you at lunch!
